admission.contract: md_html admits a byte-counted Markdown buffer by forwarding the exact input_size into md_parse.
admission.predicate: html_call.hit && parse_ctx.hit && parse_ctx.time >= html_call.time && html_call.input_size == parse_ctx.ctx_size
limitations: This shows length-delimited admission, not the presence of a specific embedded NUL from the public issue sample.
The contract is bound to the md_html entrypoint; callers using md_parse directly would bypass the first event.

root.contract: Inline mark collection preserves an embedded NUL byte as a resolved mark instead of treating it as end-of-input.
limitations: This establishes NUL-byte preservation during parsing, not the reported overflow itself.
It depends on execution reaching inline mark collection for the line containing the embedded NUL.

target.contract: The same resolved NUL mark is later consumed by inline emission as MD_TEXT_NULLCHAR.
target.predicate: emit_null.hit && emit_null.mark_ch == 0 && emit_null.mark_beg == root.null_mark.mark_beg && emit_null.time >= root.null_mark.time
limitations: This is a parser-level propagation sink, not a demonstrated overflowing write.
The public issue reports a buffer overflow, but the vulnerable write site is not defensibly identifiable from the issue text and source alone.
